findings.title: The environment update fails on Linux
findings.body: `sed -i ''` is the macOS/BSD form of in-place editing; GNU sed on Linux treats the empty argument as a backup suffix and then fails to parse the remaining arguments. When the script is run on Linux with an existing `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` entry, it exits without updating the URL, so webhook testing continues to target the old endpoint.

findings.title: Deleting cache leaves the displayed cache status stale
findings.body: The delete mutation's success handler does not invalidate or refetch `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`, unlike the disconnect mutation. After deleting cached rows, the query still contains the old `cacheUpdatedAt`, so the dropdown continues to show cache status and a delete action even though the cache was removed; this persists until some unrelated refetch or page reload.
